g.text: UML sequence - approved periodic preview policies (no financial posting)
Submit synthetic policy, complete calendar, reason
Current Finance maker role + REVIEW queue
Validate exact immutable product and policy range
Commit immutable intent, policy digest, expiry and audit
[Worker recovers at most 50 requests, wrapping past failures]
Register original proposal ID + exact policy digest
Review material policy, calendar, digest and expiry
A lost publication response is recovered from Core's immutable receipt.
No money command or account enrollment is exposed by this capability.
Read saved request after lost acknowledgment
Read original policy ID and approval identity
Supply period, evaluation clock and preview basis
Read original policy and validate digest
Exact fraction / rounded amount / rolled UTC cutoff
